summary: Official Philippine and local Legazpi sources evidence cadastral-map/tax-map custody and procedures. The current Geoportal Philippines lot-plotter was inspected and its bounded public requests returned location/tie-point metadata but no parcel polygon feature response, schema, CRS, or stable native parcel identity. No GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Filipino/Tagalog discovery queries, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-4785-legazpi.json.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200 HTML. Official viewer code exposed the lot-plotter UI, module scripts, Geoportal layer endpoints, and a server-side slider CAPTCHA component. It did not expose a parcel feature layer or anonymous parcel download URL. No CAPTCHA interaction or bypass was attempted.
HTTP 200 JSON. Returned the province list, including ALBAY; this is location metadata only.
HTTP 200 JSON. Returned municipality labels including LEGAZPI and LEGASPI; this is location metadata only.
HTTP 200 JSON. Returned tie-point references and numeric tie-point IDs for Legazpi. These are survey-control metadata, not parcel polygons or parcel identities.
HTTP 200 JSON. Returned additional tie-point references, including Legaspi Cadastre references. No parcel geometry was returned.
HTTP 200 JSON. Returned Geoportal sector/category metadata only; no parcel feature response.
HTTP 200 JSON with success=false and no layer found. This is evidence that the guessed generic layer name was not present, not evidence of cadastral absence.
HTTP 500 JSON reporting a missing database relation for the guessed generic layer. No further layer-name guessing or unsafe fields were requested.

Official FOI pages were found in discovery. The LRA response directs the requester to DENR for a cadastral map; the DENR-LMB record documents a completed response with an attachment, but no parcel vector endpoint or safe geometry response was available for this research pass.
Official/local city information identifies the City Assessor's Office and tax-map viewing/real-property record procedures. No anonymous parcel geometry service was documented.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [13.1496163977733, 123.733536495319] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The official Geoportal requests were bounded and browser-like headers plus a cookie jar and viewer Referer were used; no credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS exception was used.
Location and tie-point responses do not prove parcel-vector availability, completeness, citywide coverage, or exact-point parcel intersection.
The official FOI and city assessor evidence establishes local custody/procedure but not an open machine-readable parcel API.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or unsafe registration fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research bookkeeping only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains required.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
source layer and public service metadata
crs: unverified; no parcel geometry response obtained

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not performed because no verified public parcel feature service was found.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: DENR/LMB cadastral-map custody for Legazpi and Legazpi City Assessor tax-map/real-property records; Geoportal Philippines public GIS platform.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public location/tie-point metadata and map application shell only; anonymous parcel geometry and citywide open coverage were not verified.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review and adapter qualification still required
uncertainty: The current Geoportal cadastral layer name, service endpoint, schema, CRS, native parcel identity, access conditions, and coverage remain unresolved. The FOI attachment and any non-public DENR/LMB records were not treated as machine-readable geometry. No claim is made about parcel absence, legal title, ownership, completeness, or currency.
